user.title: Sign in to Pawport
user.description: Use the email address of your Pawport account. Google and Apple sign-in can't be used here; if your account uses one of them, try an emailed code.

method.title: How do you want to sign in?

password.title: Enter your password
password.description: The password for {email}. It is stored so the integration can sign in again on its own when its session expires.

error.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired.

abort.invalid_email: Pawport did not accept that email address.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in to a different Pawport account than the one this entry belongs to.

auth_failed.message: Pawport rejected the saved session. Sign in again to continue.

command_failed.message: The door did not accept the command: {error}
